requirement: Stamp updatedAt on every semantic writer and add the userId/updatedAt index through the existing migration workflow.

stamp.semantic: A write is semantic when it can change a field of ANALYSIS_GAME_PROJECTION or the row's corpus membership (_deleted, _deletionPending, excluded, isResumedFromReplay).
stamp.changeAware: Pipeline updates, and $set/$unset updates converted to literal pipeline stages, move updatedAt only when a served field or membership flag changes; an unchanged row stays byte-identical.
stamp.always: Updates with other operators (the ingest upsert's $setOnInsert form) and inserted or replacement rows always stamp.
stamp.clock: The API process clock when the write is issued; readers keep an overlap window.

writers.restore: Restored games rows are stamped before the retryable insert.
outOfBand: db/migrations/2026-09-30-rename-8-pool-builds.js (semantic; a re-run needs a corpus refresh)

index.name: games_user_updated_at
index.workflow: Its own background producer (apps/api/src/db/corpusIndexes.js), started by ensureIndexes without holding boot and outside the guide builds GuideStats waits on.

fixed: The corpus stamp index left the guide background builds, whose readiness GuideStats waits on, for its own producer (db/corpusIndexes.js).
The index key gained _id so a delta reader can page rows that one bulk write stamped alike without a second full build.
withUpdatedAt refuses numeric path segments, overlapping paths and an empty update, and skips an empty $unset stage.
Real-Mongo cases cover a no-op write on a never-stamped row and a macro change and no-change.

documented: Info: newly added fields land in update order rather than MongoDB's order; served field order is unchanged.
